service.description: Send a text from fromNumber (empty: the system's number, VoicePolicy.smsSystemNumber, which needs a messaging bridge) straight to its provider, kept in no room, so a sign-in code is seen by nobody else. userId: who it is from (their caller-ID grants and limits); empty, the system's limits. The checks before the provider are SmsServices.check#SmsSend's: the destination's class (international and premium off until enabled), the person's opt-out (STOP), the day's limits, and for isPromotional a yes from an sms-consent provider. A refusal is an error, with reasonCode. Not callable from outside the server.

parameter.name: contactNumber
parameter.description: If there is a single string for phone number pass it here, may include a country code if begins with '+'

parameter.name: fromNumber
parameter.description: One of our numbers with messaging; empty for the system's

parameter.name: userId
parameter.description: Who sends it, for their grants and limits; empty for the system
